movie.title: Lockbox
movie.overview: A woman puts her life on the line to protect her troubled, enigmatic cousin, Winthrop, who has been targeted and hunted by a powerful supernatural force.

reviews.author: Sierbahnn
reviews.content: This is a competent horror movie about PTSD and grieving families, then it becomes an entirely different movie after about an hour or so and turns into a religious supernatural horror movie which has very little to do with anything that has happened up to that point. It is an abrupt shift and one that I'm not sure the movie sustains adequately. It is certainly not a bad movie, and I enjoyed watching it, but the abrupt tonal shift is a bit much. It is well acted and the limited use of special effects is effective. It's still a good time. You just have to be prepared for the whiplash that signals the start of the third act.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When her enigmatic, troubled cousin becomes the target of a relentless supernatural force, a brave woman risks everything to keep him alive.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Desperate to protect her family, a woman steps into harm's way when her troubled cousin Winthrop is hunted by an ancient, otherworldly entity. As the supernatural threat intensifies, dark secrets surrounding Winthrop's past begin to emerge, blurring the lines between protector and victim. Trapped in a escalating nightmare, she must decipher the true nature of the force hunting them before it destroys them both.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Bound by family loyalty, a woman steps in to shield her troubled and enigmatic cousin, Winthrop, when he suddenly becomes the target of a terrifying supernatural force. As Winthrop's behavior grows increasingly strange, she begins investigating the obscure origins of the malevolent entity pursuing him. She quickly discovers that Winthrop is hiding a dark secrets linked to an ancient artifact known as the lockbox. With every passing night, the demonic force grows more powerful, staging terrifying attacks that test her physical and emotional endurance. Realizing that conventional escape is impossible, she turns to forbidden lore to find a way to contain the entity. However, as the entity's influence spreads, trust between the cousins begins to erode, raising doubts about who is truly in control. Facing relentless terror, she must make a agonizing sacrifice to lock away the evil before it consumes Winthrop's soul and claims her life as well.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Lockbox is a chilling atmospheric horror-drama that delves into the dangerous bonds of blood and the consequences of hidden secrets. The story centers on a determined woman who finds herself thrust into a supernatural nightmare when her enigmatic cousin, Winthrop, arrives seeking refuge from an incomprehensible power. As a malevolent entity relentlessly hunts Winthrop, his devoted relative places her life on the line to shield him, uncovering sinister truths about his past along the way. Blending psychological tension with supernatural terror, Lockbox explores how far one will go to protect family when the forces arrayed against them defy natural law.
